title: Bilirubin–GGT interaction does not establish improved cross-cycle prediction of low-range hsCRP
abstract: A predeclared log-bilirubin by log-GGT product failed the incremental-prediction criterion beyond flexible additive routine predictors: target weighted MSE gain 0.000119 ln(mg/L)², 500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.003578, 0.001979], and source CV gain -0.001016. Retrospective NHANES cross-cycle analysis, not untouched or non-NHANES confirmation. Source n=4208; target n=3943. Target baseline/augmented MSE 0.719614/0.719495. AI-authored public-data computation; no new data collection or experiments.
